title: Don to Farzi: 7 Bollywood heist and crime dramas to watch

 Don to Farzi: 7 Bollywood heist and crime dramas to watch 
 Pics via IMDb
 Mid-Day 
 Entertainment 
 By Rachel Pereira Published Oct 21, 2026 
 Chaar Yaar 
 Set in early-2000s Mumbai, this Prime Video crime drama follows four friends whose fateful decision draws them into a dangerous world of gangsters and police 
 Dhoom 
 Fast bikes, daring robberies and high-speed chases define Dhoom. John Abraham leads a gang of thieves, with Abhishek Bachchan and Uday Chopra hot on the trail 
 Don 
 Shah Rukh Khan plays an underworld kingpin and his lookalike in this crime thriller. With shifting identities, dangerous secrets and uncertain loyalties 
 Farzi 
 Shahid Kapoor plays Sunny, an artist drawn into counterfeiting to save his grandfather’s printing press. His criminal venture leads to a dangerous game 
 Bunty Aur Babli 
 Two small-town dreamers turn into a notorious con duo, pulling off audacious scams across India. Abhishek Bachchan and Rani Mukerji lead this tale

 Special 26 
 Akshay Kumar leads a gang posing as CBI and income tax officers to conduct fake raids on the wealthy. But their elaborate con faces exposure ahead 
 Crew 
 Kareena Kapoor, Tabu and Kriti Sanon play flight attendants caught in a gold-smuggling racket. What starts as a way out of financial trouble gets complicated
